scope: Full Playwright suite against current UI, including mandatory actual fixture-backend chat and legacy journeys; no live scholarly/model calls.

tests.title: actual fixture chat routes separate providers, reuses saved evidence and reopens without a search
actual fixture DOI chat routes to DataCite without creating a discovery run
exploration renders early separate-provider sources, retains drafts and cancels without duplicate search
a public DOI works with OpenAlex blocked and saved follow-up does not introduce year filters
exploration remains usable on a narrow phone and keeps over-budget input editable
local fixture services reach a saved shortlist and deterministic export
first rows can be inspected and saved before completion; updates preserve identity and focus
reopen and exports use saved state; DOI observations remain separate and stale writes retain drafts
provider edits are explicit and reconnection cannot rerun research or duplicate sources
mobile keyboard flow, modal focus and reading layout remain usable
three-paper cap and eligibility updates preserve human decisions visibly
untitled and truncated records remain honest and DOI checks require inclusion
desktop split preview, notes and display preferences use existing saved data
Dub-inspired workspace remains readable at tablet and narrow phone widths
